sloka: हम्सो यथा राजतपञ्जरसथः ।सिम्हो यथा मन्दरकन्दरस्थः ।वीरो यथा गर्वितकुञ्जरस्थ ।श्चन्द्रो विबभ्राज तथामभरस्थः ॥५-५-४॥
transliteration: hamso yathā rājatapañjarasathaḥ ।simho yathā mandarakandarasthaḥ ।vīro yathā garvitakuñjarastha ।ścandro vibabhrāja tathāmabharasthaḥ ॥5-5-4॥

translations.english: 'Like a swan in a cage of silver, like a lion in a cave of Mandara mountain, like a hero on a proud, intoxicated elephant, the Moon shone in the sky.
